fusions.name: Strand Storm
fusions.desc: Looses 6 strands in a wide spread, each dealing 2 damage with a 30% chance of leaving the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Tuft Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a tuft of fine down into the first enemy it meets for 3 damage, with a 30% chance of [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristling Ruff
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Layered Preening
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
